components.css: .ds-hero { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 24px; min-height: 520px; background: #f5f2eb; color: #16150f; overflow: hidden; } .ds-hero__text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; padding: 48px 0 48px 40px; gap: 48px; } .ds-hero__title { margin: 0; font: 360 64px/1 Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-variation-settings: 'opsz' 72; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-line { display: block; overflow: hidden; padding-bottom: 0.12em; margin-bottom: -0.12em; } .ds-line > span { display: inline-block; animation: ds-rise 850ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 0.84, 0.24, 1) both; animation-delay: calc(150ms + var(--i) * 120ms); } .ds-hero__foot { display: grid; gap: 24px; padding-top: 24px; border-top: 1px solid rgb(22 21 15 / 0.18); } .ds-hero__foot p { margin: 0; font: 400 18px/1.6 Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #3d3a33; max-width: 44ch; } .ds-hero__btn { justify-self: start; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 24px; border-radius: 8px; background: #1a4be0; color: #ffffff; font: 500 16px/1 Outfit, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-hero__btn:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, #1a4be0 86%, #16150f); } .ds-hero__btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a4be0; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-hero__mask { background: #e6e0d3; border-top-left-radius: 120px; animation: ds-settle 1200ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.7, 0.2, 1) 50ms both; } @keyframes ds-rise { from { transform: translateY(110%); } to { transform: none; } } @keyframes ds-settle { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.08); } to { opacity: 1; transform: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-line > span, .ds-hero__mask { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site should read like a premium firm's printed brief: a serif headline set large on warm paper, a thin rule, a few plain sentences, one clear action, and a photograph given real room. Confidence comes from restraint and from facts the reader can check (the license number, the credential checks, the named owners), never from decoration. The visitor is usually a facility manager filling a gap in a schedule, so the page is calm, quick to scan and certain about what to do next.

Density is low and deliberate. Generous margins, asymmetric halves and long horizontal hairlines do the structuring that boxes and cards did before. Rhythm across a page comes from alternating warm paper sections with deep near-black ones, and from photography cropped under large rounded masks. Motion is measured: headlines rise line by line, photographs settle into place, buttons answer in about 200ms, and nothing moves for its own sake.

This system replaces the site's original look (pure white ground, Outfit headlines, kit cards on grey). The home hero is the first section built in it and is the reference for every section that follows; the rest of the site is legacy until it is moved over. The words never change: every visible string lives in `content/content.ts` and is locked by `content-lock.md`.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground (no pure white pages), alternating with near-black sections for rhythm.
Fraunces display headlines at large sizes against an Outfit body: big size contrast.
Credential Blue as the only accent, on actions and the focus ring.
Thin hairline dividers and small uppercase labels instead of boxes.
Full-bleed photographs under large rounded masks.
Transform-and-opacity motion only, still under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Credential Blue appears only where the visitor acts or where one word is highlighted. No blue backgrounds, panels, icons or decorative strokes.

rules.name: The Paper, Not White Rule
rules.body: No section ground is pure white (#ffffff). Light sections are Paper; deep sections are Night.

rules.name: The Size Contrast Rule
rules.body: A headline is at least three times its body text on desktop (96px over 18px in the hero). Middle sizes between 24px and 48px are avoided; contrast comes from the jump, not from many steps.

rules.name: The Optical Size Rule
rules.body: Fraunces keeps its optical size at 72 even at 96px, so its hairlines stay sturdy enough for a healthcare business rather than turning into fashion-magazine Didone.

rules.name: The Half and Bleed Rule
rules.body: Pair a text half with a photograph that runs to the screen edge. Never centre a short block of text in an empty screen.

rules.name: The Flat Paper Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow on cards, panels or buttons in new sections. Separation is a hairline, a change of ground, or space.

rules.name: The One Big Corner Rule
rules.body: A masked photograph rounds one corner generously, the corner that faces the text; the other three stay square to the screen edges.

dos: Do set every light section on Paper (#f5f2eb) and every deep section on Night (#111111).
Do keep Credential Blue (#1a4be0) for actions, the focus ring and one highlighted word, nothing else.
Do set headlines in Fraunces 360 with its optical size held at 72, and body text in Outfit at 17 to 18px.
Do separate content with 1px hairlines (rgb(22 21 15 / 0.18)) and space rather than boxes.
Do reveal headlines line by line behind masks (700 to 900ms, staggered) and let photographs settle from 1.08 to 1, animating only transform and opacity.
Do make every animation stand still and in place under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do keep the EO logo as supplied, in the header and the footer.
donts: Don't change any visible text; copy comes only from `content/content.ts` and is locked by `content-lock.md`.
Don't use pure white (#ffffff) as a page or section ground.
Don't introduce a second accent colour, a gradient on interface elements, or blue used as decoration.
Don't animate width, height, top, left or colour for entrances; only transform and opacity.
Don't add drop shadows to new cards, panels or buttons.
Don't let Fraunces run at full optical size at display sizes; hold it at 72.
